data.name: RuJuWi
data.detailed_description:
Run, Jump, Win! Build your own levels, share them and play the levels the other players created!

RuJuWi is a fun little platform game that lets you create your own levels, play them as the little slime Puya and share them with others via the Workshop. Use blocks and platforms to create the base structure of your level, fill it with power-ups, enemies and various objects. You can even use mechanisms, allowing you to make logical circuits to move platforms, create blocks or open doors! Finally, add some decorations in the background to really personalize your levels!

This game contains:

  • Dozens of Blocks and Platforms to shape your world as you want: from the classic plains to the frozen heights, a fiery volcano and modern buildings!

  • Pickups to help Puya through her adventure: more health, more jumps, invincibility time and keys to open doors.

  • Powerups that make Puya stronger by allowing her to dash, fly, climb walls, drill and even more! Whether to help her mobility or to defeat enemies, powerups are essentials!

  • Of course, Enemies are here too! They walk, run, dash, fly, even explode, but most of all, they want you gone!

  • Mechanisms to make your level a little more "brainy". There's everything you need: buttons, switches, targets, timers, doors, teleporters, fans... And even logical gates to link them up!

  • Some Objects will also help Puya during her adventures: boulders and boxes to climb higher, geysers to make her fly, bumpers and shooters to send her in every direction. However, be careful to not end up on some pikes, it could be... deadly.

  • You can also change the rules of your levels, by adding water and lava flooding the level, make it night time, reducing the field of vision of Puya, end even change gravity!

Make whatever YOU want and play whatever YOU want!
